name: Timing
description: Represents timing properties for an animation effect.
remarks: Use the following read/write properties of the Timing object to manipulate animation timing effects.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Duration
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of an animation in seconds. Read/write.

properties.name: TriggerType
properties.description: Represents the trigger that starts an animation. Read/write.

properties.name: TriggerDelayTime
properties.description: Sets or returns the delay, in seconds, from when an animation trigger is enabled. Read/write.

properties.name: TriggerShape
properties.description: Sets or returns a Shape object that represents the shape associated with an animation trigger. Read/write.

properties.name: RepeatCount
properties.description: Sets or returns the number of times to repeat an animation. Read/write.

properties.name: RepeatDuration
properties.description: Sets or returns how long repeated animations should last, in seconds. Read/write.

properties.name: Speed
properties.description: Returns or sets the speed, in seconds, of the specified animation. Read/write.

properties.name: Accelerate
properties.description: Returns or sets the percentage of the duration over which a timing acceleration should take place. Read/write.

properties.name: Decelerate
properties.description: Sets or returns the percentage of the duration over which a timing deceleration should take place. Read/write.

properties.name: AutoReverse
properties.description: Determines whether an effect should play forward and then in reverse, thereby doubling its duration. Read/write.

properties.name: SmoothStart
properties.description: Determines whether an animation should accelerate when it starts. Read/write.

properties.name: SmoothEnd
properties.description: Determines whether an animation should decelerate as it ends. Read/write.

properties.name: RewindAtEnd
properties.description: Represents whether an object returns to its beginning position after an animation has ended. Read/write.

properties.name: Restart
properties.description: Represents whether the animation effect restarts after the effect has started once. Read/write.
